manifest.name: Whiteboard
manifest.description: A shared, endless board for your voice channel: sketch, add sticky notes, present with a laser and export as PNG, SVG or PDF.
stage.title: Whiteboard
status.saveFull: Not saved: storage is full. Delete old boards under Board settings → Saved boards.
status.saveFailed: Not saved on this device. It will try again.
announce.notAllowed: You can't change the board right now: the host decides who may draw.
announce.boardFull: The board is full. Remove something before adding more.
announce.cleared: The board was cleared. Undo is possible for 30 seconds.
card.hint: Draw together on one shared board.
notice.start.title: Couldn't start the whiteboard
notice.start.notPermitted: Join a voice channel first. Starting needs a click on "Start whiteboard" or /whiteboard.
notice.start.busy: This channel already runs a whiteboard or three activities. Join the running one instead.
notice.noRandom: Mumcord could not create a board id. Try again.
notice.open.title: Couldn't open the board
notice.open.failed: The saved copy on this device is damaged or missing.
notice.join.title: Couldn't join the whiteboard
dialog.hostOnly: Only the host can change this.
dialog.area.nothingSelected: Nothing is selected. Select something on the board first, or pick another area.
dialog.area.noView: Open the board on the stage first, so it knows what you see.
dialog.export.title: Export or share "{{title}}"
dialog.export.notPermitted: Mumcord did not allow saving the file. This Mumcord version may not support it yet, or "Save files" is off for Whiteboard.
dialog.export.tooLarge: The file is too large to save.
dialog.export.failed: The file could not be made.
dialog.post.posted: Posted to chat as a picture.
dialog.post.fileOffer: Too big for a chat picture on this server, so Mumcord offered it as a file: people with Mumcord get a download card, standard Mumble clients a text line.
dialog.post.tooLarge: Too big to post, even as a file. Try a smaller area.
dialog.post.notPermitted: Mumcord did not allow posting the picture. This Mumcord version may not support it yet, or "Post pictures to chat" is off for Whiteboard.
dialog.render.noPage: Open the board on the stage first.
dialog.render.timeout: Making the picture took too long. Try again.
dialog.render.tooLarge: The picture is too large. Try a smaller size or area.
dialog.render.slow: Making the picture took too long for Mumcord to accept the click. Click again.
dialog.clear.body: This removes {{items}} for {{people}} on the board.
dialog.settings.title: Board settings
dialog.settings.introHost: You are the host. Every participant's Mumcord checks these rules, so the board stays consistent without a server.
dialog.settings.intro: The host sets these rules. Every participant's Mumcord checks them.
dialog.settings.boardTitleHint: Shown to everyone on the board.
dialog.settings.policy.selectedHint: Only selected people can draw. Others can watch and use the laser while the host presents, if allowed.
dialog.settings.policy.hostHint: Only the host draws. Presenting mode for talks.
dialog.settings.laser: Viewers may use the laser pointer
dialog.settings.removeConfirm: Remove everything {{name}} drew, for everyone? You can undo it.
dialog.settings.clearHint: Removes everything for everyone. Needs your confirmation.
dialog.settings.linesHint: They cannot see the board. Post one plain text line so they know what is going on.
dialog.lines.notPermitted: Mumcord did not allow the chat line. Turn on "Send chat messages" for Whiteboard, then click again.
line.start: {{name}} started a whiteboard. Draw together with Mumcord (Apps → Start whiteboard), or just listen in and talk along.
line.summary: "{{title}}" · {{people}} · {{items}}. Ask {{name}} for a PNG or PDF of the board.
dialog.boards.title: Saved boards
dialog.boards.privacy: Boards live on your devices. Export what you want to keep.
dialog.boards.none: No boards are saved on this device yet.
dialog.boards.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{title}}" from this device? Other people's copies stay.
dialog.boards.deleteFailed: The board could not be deleted.
dialog.describe.title: Describe board
describe.cannotDraw: You can watch; the host decides who may draw.
page.app.title: Whiteboard
page.app.label: Whiteboard canvas. Press F1 for keyboard help.
page.tools.label: Drawing tools
page.props.label: {tool} settings
page.zoom.label: History and zoom
page.act.label: Board actions
page.relay.title: This server has no relay for plugin data.
page.relay.body: Drawing works over the normal Mumble connection. Others see your strokes when you lift the pen; live cursors and the laser are limited.
page.relay.whyText: Plugin data then travels as small Mumble messages, and the server allows only a few of them per second. A relay carries live strokes, cursors and the laser at full speed; this server does not offer one.
page.readonly: View only: the host decides who may draw.
page.help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
page.help.shapes: Shapes (press again for the next shape)
page.help.hand: Hold to pan the board (or drag with the middle mouse button)
page.help.order: Bring to front / send to back
page.help.kbdMove: Move the keyboard cursor (Shift: bigger steps)
page.help.kbdPen: With the keyboard cursor: press or lift the pen
page.help.kbdPlace: Place a shape, note or text at the keyboard cursor
page.help.outline: Board outline: arrows to move, Enter to edit, Delete to remove
page.help.esc: Cancel, or go back to Mumcord
page.outline.title: Board outline
page.editor.label: Text of the {kind}
page.boards.label: Saved boards
page.mini.label: Whiteboard {title}, live preview.
page.mini.hint: Enter drops it on the board.
page.exp.toChatHint: Everyone in the channel sees it, also in a standard Mumble client
page.exp.pngHint: A picture; sent as a normal chat image
page.exp.boardHint: The whole board, to open and share again later
page.exp.names: Add names of who drew what
page.exp.namesHint: Off by default. Names stay private unless you turn this on.
page.exp.privacyFile: Mumcord opens the save window. The plugin never sees your folders.
page.exp.privacyChat: The picture goes through Mumcord's normal image sending, like a pasted image. The plugin never sees your folders.
page.clr.title: Clear the whole board?
page.clr.undoHint: Undo brings it back for the next 30 seconds. After that it only exists on devices that saved a copy.
page.clr.done: The board is empty for everyone.
